scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation
other_conditions: Individual growers, joint owners, or family members (mother, father, wife, children) may apply jointly
Applicant must have coffee holdings of up to 10 hectares
Non‑tribal coffee growers in Non‑Traditional Areas with holdings up to 10 hectares are eligible
A grower who has availed subsidy for a specific activity cannot avail it again for the same activity within 10 years
During the Multi‑Year Thrust Plan period a beneficiary cannot claim the same component again unless new beneficiaries are included
Infrastructure must be created within the coffee estate or its vicinity and the land must be in the name of the grower or the specified family members
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 40% of unit cost, capped at ₹2,50,000 per beneficiary, with an additional 10% for SC/ST growers with holdings up to 4 hectares.
documents_required: Mandatory documents as specified in the online application form
Subsidy claim in prescribed formats (in duplicate)
